test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 16 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

She said to me, "Please lend me your bicycle."

options.text: She requested me to lend her my bicycle.
She requested you to lend me her bicycle.
She requested me to lend her your bicycle.
She requested her to lend me your bicycle.

solution:
The correct answer is "**She requested me to lend her my bicycle.**"
